title: CSPD: Three arrested in stolen vehicle, stolen gun found - NewsBreak
text:
By Brett Yager No media credit provided. ,
4 hours ago
(COLORADO SPRINGS) — The Colorado Springs Police Department (CSPD) said on Tuesday, Dec. 9, three people were arrested in an alleged stolen vehicle, and detectives found an allegedly stolen firearm in the vehicle.
According to CSPD, on Monday, Dec. 7, police investigated the theft of a gray 2005 Suzuki Aerio, which was taken from the 1000 block of South Chelton Road north of East Fountain Boulevard. On Tuesday at around 8:30 p.m., police found the Suzuki in the area of Constitution Avenue and Akers Drive.
Detectives tried to stop the vehicle, but the suspects allegedly drove off and eluded law enforcement. Detectives conducted surveillance of the vehicle and followed it to the intersection of East Pikes Peak Avenue and South Academy Boulevard.
Detectives stopped the vehicle and arrested all three people inside. Detectives also found a 22-caliber loaded handgun, which police said was stolen.
Of those in the vehicle, 24-year-old Eric Diaz is facing charges of motor vehicle theft. 28-year-old Alejandro Ruiz is facing charges of eluding, motor vehicle theft, and possession of a stolen firearm. A minor was also in the vehicle, who was arrested on an alleged outstanding domestic violence Failure To Appear warrant.
